site.disclosure: As an Amazon Associate, BuyRight Notes earns from qualifying purchases. We pick products from published specs and our own notes, not paid placements.

products.title: Breville Bambino, 54 mm espresso
products.reason_to_buy: Compact espresso for a small kitchen: ready in about 3 seconds, and its 54 mm accessories are easy to find.
products.detail:
We chose it for small kitchens: it heats in about 3 seconds and takes 54 mm accessories, which are easy to find.
+ Compact footprint for a tight counter
+ Fast heat-up for weekday mornings
+ 54 mm portafilter: tampers and baskets are easy to find
Size: 6.3 in wide, 12 in tall, 13.7 in deep; 10.9 lb
Fits: 54 mm baskets and tampers; four baskets, a tamper and a steel milk jug come in the box
Tank: 47 oz, lifts out at the back
Skip it if you want a built-in grinder. Measure your cabinet clearance first.

checks: Counter and cabinet clearance: it is 12 in tall and 13.7 in deep, and the 47 oz tank lifts out at the back, so leave a gap behind it or plan to reach over.
Accessory size: 54 mm. Buy tampers, baskets and funnels sold for Breville 54 mm, not 'universal' 58 mm ones.
Grind plan: no built-in grinder. It ships with pressurized and non-pressurized baskets, so you can start on pre-ground and add an espresso grinder later.
page_notes.fit: A small kitchen that wants cafe-style milk drinks from a machine that is hot in about 3 seconds.
page_notes.not_fit: Anyone who wants a grinder built in, or who already owns 58 mm tools.

products.image_alt: A Breville Bambino espresso machine in brushed stainless steel on a walnut counter, a latte with heart latte art, a jar of coffee beans and a pothos beside it.

products.title: Baratza Encore ESP burr grinder
products.reason_to_buy: An espresso-capable burr grinder that is quiet enough for an early house and fits under a cabinet.
products.detail:
We chose it because it grinds fine enough for espresso, stays quiet enough for an early house, and fits under a cabinet.
+ Stepped burrs with a true espresso range: settings 1 to 20 for espresso, 21 to 40 for filter coffee
+ Pulse button on the front and a dosing cup that catches the grounds
+ Compact enough for under-cabinet counters
Size: 5.1 in wide, 13.4 in tall, 5.9 in deep; 5.6 lb
Fits: any 51 to 58 mm machine, including both espresso machines here
Hopper: 120 g of beans
Burrs: 40 mm steel
Skip it if you only make drip coffee; a simpler grinder will do.

checks: Your machine's basket size: the dosing cup is 54 mm and a 58 mm adapter is in the box; a 51 mm machine works with the cup held under the chute.
Espresso range: settings 1 to 20 are for espresso, 21 to 40 for filter coffee, so one grinder covers both if you also brew drip or pour-over.
Counter height: 13.4 in tall with the 120 g hopper on, which clears most under-cabinet spaces.
page_notes.fit: A first espresso setup where the machine ships with a pressurized basket and you want to move to fresh beans and a non-pressurized basket.
page_notes.not_fit: Drip-only households; a simpler grinder does that job for less.

products.image_alt: A black Baratza Encore ESP coffee grinder with a clear bean hopper on a speckled quartz counter, its dosing cup full of grounds, with a portafilter, tamper and espresso cup beside it.

products.title: CASABREWS espresso machine, 51 mm
products.reason_to_buy: A first espresso machine at a starter price, with one catch: it takes 51 mm baskets, and most accessory kits do not.
products.detail:
We chose it as the starter espresso machine, with one catch: it takes 51 mm baskets.
+ Simple, small and easy to start with
+ Steam wand for milk drinks
+ Pressure gauge on the front, so you can watch the shot
Size: 5.5 in wide, 12 in tall, 12.3 in deep; 8.6 lb
Fits: 51 mm baskets only; a one-cup and a two-cup basket are included
Tank: 34 oz, removable
Skip it if you already own 54 or 58 mm tools; buy 51 mm accessories only.

checks: Accessory size: 51 mm, and most kits are 54 or 58 mm. Search accessories by the model name CM5418, not by 'universal'.
Baskets: a one-cup and a two-cup pressurized basket come in the box, so pre-ground espresso works from day one.
Tank and footprint: 34 oz removable tank, 5.5 in wide and 12.3 in deep; check the depth against your counter.
page_notes.fit: A starter espresso machine for someone who wants steam-wand milk drinks at a small price and is happy to buy 51 mm accessories.
page_notes.not_fit: Anyone who already owns 54 or 58 mm tampers and baskets, or wants a grinder built in.

products.image_alt: A stainless CASABREWS CM5418 espresso machine with a pressure gauge on a marble counter, a glass cup of espresso on the drip tray and biscotti beside it.

products.title: Keurig K-Classic, 3 cup sizes
products.reason_to_buy: Pod coffee with nothing to measure: drop in a K-Cup, press one of three buttons, and pour in about a minute.
products.detail:
We chose it for the simplest possible morning: one pod, one button, a hot cup in about a minute, nothing to measure.
+ Three cup sizes: 6, 8 or 10 oz (6 oz is the strongest)
+ 48 oz tank lifts off the side to refill at the sink
+ Turns itself off after two hours idle
Size: 13.3 in wide, 13 in tall, 9.8 in deep (17.6 in with the lid open); 9 lb
Fits: K-Cup pods; a travel mug up to 7.1 in tall
Includes: 4 K-Cup pods, a water filter handle and 2 filters
Skip it if you want espresso, milk drinks or a full pot.

checks: Height with the lid open: about 17.6 in. Measure under your cabinets before you order.
Pods only: it brews K-Cup pods, in 6, 8 or 10 oz. It does not make espresso, milk drinks or a full pot.
Tank access: the 48 oz tank lifts off the side, so it needs room on that side, not behind.
page_notes.fit: A fast hot cup with nothing to measure, and a travel mug up to 7.1 in tall under the spout.
page_notes.not_fit: Espresso or latte drinkers, and anyone avoiding single-use pods.

products.image_alt: A black Keurig K-Classic pod coffee maker, KEURIG on its silver band, brewing into a red mug on a walnut kitchen counter.

products.title: BISSELL Little Green Mini, spot cleaner
products.reason_to_buy: A small spot cleaner for spills and pet accidents: it sprays, scrubs and lifts the mess from couches, rugs and car seats.
products.detail:
We chose it because it handles the messes that actually happen: coffee on the couch, a pet accident on the rug, crumbs in car seats.
+ Sprays, scrubs and suctions in one pass
+ Stain tool and self-rinsing hose tool included
+ Small enough to keep in a closet
Size: 13.5 in wide, 12.1 in tall, 10 in deep; 7 lb
Tank: 16 oz
Includes: 4 in tough stain tool, HydroRinse self-cleaning hose tool, 8 oz of Little Green formula
Power: corded
Skip it if you need to clean whole rooms of carpet. Empty and rinse the dirty-water tank after each use.

checks: It is a spot cleaner: a 16 oz tank for couch cushions, rug stains, stairs and car seats, not whole-room carpet.
Corded: check that an outlet reaches the spot you clean most, or plan an extension cord.
Formula: 8 oz comes in the box; the manual names what else is safe to use in the tank.
page_notes.fit: Homes with pets, kids or a fabric couch, where the same small messes happen every week.
page_notes.not_fit: Anyone who needs to deep-clean whole rooms; rent or buy a full-size carpet cleaner for that.

products.image_alt: A pale green BISSELL Little Green Mini spot cleaner with its coiled hose on an oak floor beside a cream sofa.

products.title: Ninja Professional Blender, 72 oz
products.reason_to_buy: Enough power to crush ice for frozen drinks, and a pitcher big enough to make smoothies for the whole family at once.
products.detail:
We chose it for families who blend big: enough power for ice and frozen fruit, and a pitcher that makes smoothies for everyone at once.
+ 1000-watt motor with stacked blades
+ 72 oz pitcher, 64 oz of liquid
+ Low, medium, high and pulse buttons
Size: 8.3 in wide, 15.9 in tall, 10.7 in deep; 7.1 lb
Pitcher: 72 oz, BPA-free, dishwasher safe
Includes: motor base, pitcher with lid, recipe guide
Skip it if you want a quiet blender, a single-serve cup or hot soups. The blades are sharp when you wash the pitcher.

checks: Height: 15.9 in tall, so it may not live under a cabinet; the base is 8.3 in wide.
Pitcher: 72 oz, holds 64 oz of liquid, BPA-free and dishwasher safe. The stacked blades are sharp when you wash it.
No heating mode, so hot soups stay on the stove.
page_notes.fit: Families and hosts who blend big batches: smoothies for four, frozen drinks by the pitcher.
page_notes.not_fit: Anyone who wants a quiet blender or single-serve cups.

products.image_alt: A Ninja Professional blender full of berry smoothie, NINJA and its button labels on the charcoal base, on a walnut counter with strawberries.

products.title: La Roche-Posay Hyalu B5 serum
products.reason_to_buy: A simple hydrating step: hyaluronic acid plus vitamin B5, a few drops before your moisturizer.
products.detail:
We chose it as one simple hydrating step you can add without rebuilding your routine: a few drops before moisturizer.
+ Hyaluronic acid plus vitamin B5
+ Dropper bottle, a few drops at a time
+ The brand says it suits sensitive skin
Size: 1 oz (30 ml) dropper bottle
Formula: hyaluronic acid, glycerin, vitamin B5 and madecassoside; oil-free, per the brand
Skin: all skin types, including sensitive, per the brand
Skip it if you want to treat a skin condition; that is a question for a dermatologist. Patch-test first if your skin reacts easily.

checks: Where it goes: a few drops on clean, slightly damp skin, before moisturizer.
Sensitive skin: La Roche-Posay describes it as suitable for sensitive skin; patch-test on the jaw for a few days first if you react easily.
One product at a time: add it alone and give it two weeks before judging it or adding the next.
page_notes.fit: One simple hydrating step for dry-air months, without rebuilding a routine.
page_notes.not_fit: Treating a skin condition; that is a question for a dermatologist, not a serum.

products.image_alt: A La Roche-Posay Hyalu B5 serum dropper bottle on a marble bathroom shelf beside a glass of water, a waffle towel and peony petals.

products.title: eufy E25 robot vacuum and mop
products.reason_to_buy: Vacuums and mops in one run, then empties, washes its mop and refills itself at the dock.
products.detail:
We chose it for hands-off floors: it vacuums and mops in one run, then empties, washes and dries itself at the dock.
+ Roller mop rinsed with clean water as it works
+ Dock empties dust, dries the mop and refills water
+ Side arm reaches along baseboards and corners
Size: the dock is 18.2 in wide, 17.2 in tall and 14.6 in deep; 37.5 lb boxed
Runtime: up to 125 minutes vacuuming and mopping; the dust bag lasts about 75 days
Works with: the eufy app on 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi only; Alexa, Google Assistant and Siri
Skip it if you have no wall space for a tall dock. Dust bags and mop parts get replaced over time.

checks: Dock footprint: 18.2 in wide, 17.2 in tall and 14.6 in deep against a wall, with an outlet. Measure that spot first.
Floors: best on hard floors and low carpet; thick rugs and stairs still need an upright or stick vacuum.
Wi-Fi: the app connects on 2.4 GHz only. Dust bags (about 75 days each) and mop parts are consumables.
page_notes.fit: Busy homes with pets, where hair comes back daily and nobody is home to chase it.
page_notes.not_fit: Small spaces with no wall room for a tall dock.

products.image_alt: A eufy E25 robot vacuum docked in its tall charcoal station in a warm living room with oak floors.

products.title: KitchenAid Artisan stand mixer, 5 qt
products.reason_to_buy: The stand mixer for big batches: 10 speeds, a 5-quart bowl and a head that tilts back for adding ingredients.
products.detail:
We chose it for bakers who make big batches: the 5-quart bowl mixes about 9 dozen cookies at once.
+ 10 speeds, from a slow stir to whipping cream
+ Tilt-head design makes adding ingredients easy
+ Over 20 colors, so it can match your kitchen
Size: 14.3 in wide, 14 in tall, 9.3 in deep; 22 lb
Includes: 5-quart stainless bowl, flat beater, dough hook, 6-wire whip and pouring shield
Fits: every KitchenAid power-hub attachment (pasta roller, food grinder and more, sold separately), per KitchenAid
Skip it if you bake only a few times a year; a hand mixer will do.

checks: Counter space: 14.3 in wide, 14 in tall, 22 lb. It stays out, so pick its spot before it arrives.
Batch size: the 5-quart bowl handles about 9 dozen cookies or a bread dough; a tilt head makes adding ingredients easy under cabinets.
What is in the box: bowl, flat beater, dough hook, wire whip and pouring shield. Attachments like the pasta roller are sold separately.
page_notes.fit: Bakers who bake most weeks, make bread or cookie dough in quantity, or want the attachment hub later.
page_notes.not_fit: A few bakes a year; a hand mixer does that for a fraction of the price and space.

products.image_alt: A pistachio-green KitchenAid Artisan tilt-head stand mixer with a stainless bowl on a cream quartz counter beside a glazed pumpkin loaf and mini pumpkins.

products.title: Lodge enameled Dutch oven, 6 qt
products.reason_to_buy: One heavy pot for crusty no-knead bread, soups and stews: it holds heat evenly and is oven-safe to 500°F.
products.detail:
We chose it as the affordable way into enameled cast iron for bread and cozy fall dinners.
+ Oven-safe to 500°F, hot enough for crusty no-knead bread
+ Enamel means no rust worries; dishwasher safe, hand washing recommended
+ PFAS-free, per Lodge
Size: 6 qt; about 10.75 in across, 13.5 in handle to handle, 7.3 in tall; 14.9 lb
Works with: any stovetop, and the oven to 500°F
Care: hand wash with warm soapy water and a nylon brush, per Lodge
Skip it if a heavy pot is hard for you to lift.

checks: Weight: 14.9 lb empty and much more full of stew. If lifting a heavy pot is hard, that is the reason to skip it.
Oven limit: safe to 500°F, hot enough for crusty no-knead bread; check the lid knob is included in that rating in the manual.
Care: enamel means no seasoning, but Lodge recommends hand washing with warm soapy water and a nylon brush.
page_notes.fit: A first enameled Dutch oven for bread, soups and braises; 6 quarts fits a loaf or a family stew.
page_notes.not_fit: Anyone who cannot lift a heavy pot safely, or who wants a small pot for one.

products.image_alt: A red Lodge enameled cast-iron Dutch oven with its lid on, on a rustic wooden table beside a crusty bread loaf, bowls of soup and small pumpkins.

products.title: Kindle Paperwhite 16 GB
products.reason_to_buy: Reading without distractions: a glare-free screen that turns amber at night and a battery that lasts weeks.
products.detail:
We chose it for readers who want a book, not a tablet, at bedtime.
+ 7-inch glare-free screen that shifts from white to amber for reading in the dark
+ Up to 12 weeks on one USB-C charge
+ No social media, notifications or distracting apps
Size: 5 in by 7 in, 0.3 in thin; 7.4 oz
Screen: 7 in, 300 ppi, with an adjustable warm light
Storage: 16 GB
Works with: 2.4 and 5 GHz Wi-Fi; waterproof (IPX8), fine by the pool or in the bath
Skip it if you love the feel of paper books.

checks: Model year: this is the 7-inch, 16 GB Paperwhite. Covers and accessories are model-specific, so buy them for the 2024 generation.
Battery: up to 12 weeks per USB-C charge at Amazon's usage assumptions; heavy readers with the light up see less.
Reading at night: the warm light shifts from white to amber; set it to change automatically at sunset.
page_notes.fit: Readers who want a book at bedtime, not a tablet: no apps, no notifications, waterproof for the bath.
page_notes.not_fit: People who love paper books, or who want color comics and magazines.

products.image_alt: A black Kindle Paperwhite on a wooden side table beside a cup of tea, a lit candle, reading glasses and a knit throw, with a blue armchair behind.

products.title: Beats Studio Pro headphones
products.reason_to_buy: Quiet on demand: active noise cancelling for work and travel, with up to 40 hours of battery.
products.detail:
We chose them for home offices and commutes where focus matters.
+ Active noise cancelling, plus Transparency mode to hear the room
+ Up to 40 hours of battery; a 10-minute charge gives up to 4 hours
+ One-touch pairing with Apple and Android
Size: 7 in by 7.1 in, 3.1 in deep; 9.2 oz
Connects: Bluetooth, USB-C for lossless audio, or the 3.5 mm cable
Skip them if you want small earbuds for workouts.

checks: Fit: over-ear, 9.2 oz, so they are for the desk and the commute, not the gym.
Connections: Bluetooth, USB-C for lossless audio, or the 3.5 mm cable, so they work wired when a battery dies.
Battery: up to 40 hours, and a 10-minute charge gives about 4 hours.
page_notes.fit: A quiet home office or open-plan desk, with Transparency mode for when someone talks to you.
page_notes.not_fit: Workouts or running; small earbuds suit that better.

products.image_alt: Black Beats Studio Pro over-ear headphones resting on a light oak desk beside a closed laptop, a latte cup, a succulent and a notebook.

products.title: Hatch Baby sound machine and night light
products.reason_to_buy: A calmer bedtime routine: soft light and soothing sounds, started with one big button or from your phone.
products.detail:
We chose it for new parents building a bedtime routine from night one.
+ Soothing sounds like pink noise and heartbeat, with a soft night light
+ Big button on top to start or pause without reaching for your phone
+ Includes 3 months of Hatch+ sleep guides; optional after that
Size: 4 in wide, 5 in tall, 6 in deep; 1.7 lb
Power: plugs in (power cable included); the app connects over Wi-Fi
Colors: five, including the Putty shown here
Skip it if you would rather not use an app.

checks: It needs the app for setup and most routines over Wi-Fi; the big button on top only starts or pauses.
Power: it plugs in (cable included), so plan the outlet by the crib.
Hatch+: 3 months of sleep guides are included, then optional; sounds and light work without it.
page_notes.fit: New parents building a bedtime routine: pink noise or heartbeat, a soft night light, one button to start.
page_notes.not_fit: Anyone who would rather not run a nursery device from a phone app.

products.image_alt: A Hatch Baby sound machine and night light in putty, glowing on a wooden nursery shelf with its clock showing 7:00, beside a plush bunny, a woven basket and books.

products.title: Cosori TurboBlaze air fryer, 6 qt
products.reason_to_buy: A 6-quart air fryer for family dinners and party trays: 9 functions, 90 to 450°F, and a quieter fan than most.
products.detail:
We chose it for weeknight dinners and holiday snack trays that need to come out crisp without heating the oven.
+ Square 6 qt basket fits a whole chicken or two trays of appetizers
+ 5 fan speeds and 90 to 450°F, so it also dehydrates and reheats
+ Under 53 dB on the highest fan speed, per Cosori
Size: 14.4 x 11.8 x 11.9 in
Weight: 13.2 lb
Power: 1725 W
Includes: crisper plate, recipe book
Care: PFAS-free ceramic nonstick basket and crisper plate
Skip it if you cook for one or two: a 4 qt model takes less counter space.

checks: Counter and outlet: 14.4 x 11.8 x 11.9 in, 13.2 lb, 1725 W. Give it its own outlet and space behind for the vent.
Size: 6 qt is the family and hosting size; a 4 qt model takes less counter space for one or two people.
Care: PFAS-free ceramic nonstick basket and crisper plate, both removable for washing.
page_notes.fit: Weeknight dinners for a family and appetizer trays when the oven is full.
page_notes.not_fit: Cooking for one or two with a small counter.

products.image_alt: A dark gray Cosori TurboBlaze air fryer on a kitchen counter at night, basket open with roasted vegetables, warm lamp light and a stack of plates beside it.

products.title: Ninja CREAMi NC301 ice cream maker
products.reason_to_buy: Homemade ice cream, sorbet and milkshakes from a pint you froze overnight: 7 programs and ingredients you choose.
products.detail:
We chose it for dessert nights and holiday hosting: freeze a pint base for 24 hours, then it spins into ice cream in minutes.
+ 7 one-touch programs: ice cream, gelato, sorbet, milkshake, smoothie bowl, lite ice cream, mix-in
+ Re-spin for a softer texture; Mix-In folds in chips, nuts or cookies
+ Pints, lids and paddle are top-rack dishwasher safe
Size: 12.1 x 6.5 x 16 in
Capacity: 16 oz pints, 2 included
Includes: 2 pints with lids, Creamerizer paddle, outer bowl
Skip it if you want ice cream tonight: every batch needs a 24-hour freeze first.

checks: The 24-hour freeze: every pint base freezes overnight first, so plan dessert a day ahead.
Freezer space: 16 oz pints (two included) need a flat spot in the freezer.
Cleanup: pints, lids and paddle are top-rack dishwasher safe; the 16 in tall unit stays on the counter or in a cupboard.
page_notes.fit: Dessert nights and hosting, where a make-your-own pint station is the party trick.
page_notes.not_fit: Anyone who wants ice cream tonight, or has no freezer room for pints.

products.image_alt: A Ninja CREAMi ice cream maker on a kitchen counter at night with a pint of homemade ice cream, two bowls and a scoop, under warm lamp light.

products.title: SMIRLY bamboo charcuterie board set
products.reason_to_buy: A complete cheese-board set for the host: bamboo board with drawers, knives, bowls and slate labels, boxed for gifting.
products.detail:
We chose it as the hostess gift that gets used: everything for a cheese board arrives in one decorative box.
+ 3 slide-out drawers hold the knives and serving pieces
+ 4 bowls, a fruit tray, 2 slate labels and chalk markers included
+ Bamboo resists water and scratches, per SMIRLY; hand wash
Size: 15.7 x 13.3 x 2.6 in
Weight: about 10 lb
Includes: board, fruit tray, 4 bowls, cheese knives, 2 slate labels, 2 chalk markers
Skip it if you host rarely: it is a large board that needs cupboard space. SMIRLY is an Amazon marketplace brand, not a store name you will know.

checks: Size and storage: 15.7 x 13.3 in and about 10 lb; it needs cupboard space between parties.
Care: bamboo, hand wash only; the slate labels wipe clean.
Brand: SMIRLY is an Amazon marketplace brand, not a store name you will know; the set is the point, not the label.
page_notes.fit: Hosts and gift-givers who want the whole cheese board, knives and bowls included, in one box.
page_notes.not_fit: Rare hosts, or anyone who wants a name-brand serving piece.

products.image_alt: A SMIRLY bamboo charcuterie board set on a dining table at night, laid with cheese, grapes and crackers, drawers open, candles and a garland behind it.

products.title: Chemex 8-cup pour-over coffeemaker
products.reason_to_buy: The glass pour-over for people who like the ritual: 40 oz, borosilicate glass, wood collar, a gift that looks the part.
products.detail:
We chose it for the coffee lover who already grinds fresh: it makes a clean, bright pot and looks good on the counter.
+ Brews up to 40 oz (Chemex counts 5 oz as a cup)
+ Non-porous borosilicate glass holds no odors; the collar marks a full brew
+ Coffee can be covered and refrigerated in the carafe, per Chemex
Size: 9.6 x 6.4 in (listing dimensions)
Capacity: 40 oz, 8 Chemex cups
Works with: Chemex bonded filters FP-1, FC-100, FS-100, FSU-100 (not included)
Skip it if you want a set-and-forget pot: pour-over takes a kettle, a grinder and about 5 minutes of attention.

checks: Filters: it takes Chemex bonded filters (FP-1, FC-100, FS-100, FSU-100), not included; order a box with it.
You also need a kettle and a grinder; a gooseneck kettle makes the pour easier but is not required.
Capacity: 40 oz, which Chemex counts as 8 cups of 5 oz.
page_notes.fit: Coffee lovers who grind fresh and enjoy five minutes of pour-over, and a gift that looks the part on the counter.
page_notes.not_fit: Push-button coffee people, or anyone without a kettle and grinder.

products.image_alt: A Chemex 8-cup glass pour-over coffeemaker with a wood collar on a wood counter at night, a kettle pouring, two mugs and a small wrapped gift beside it.

products.title: Summer Fridays Lip Butter Balm
products.reason_to_buy: The overnight lip mask that doubles as a daytime balm: shea and murumuru butters, vegan waxes, subtle vanilla, no tackiness.
products.detail:
We chose it as the stocking stuffer that is still in use in March: a mask at night, a shine by day.
+ Shea and murumuru seed butters for moisture; vegan waxes for a soft shine
+ Sheer tint; Vanilla is the classic scent
+ 0.5 oz tube, purse size
Size: 0.5 oz
Formula: 100% vegan and cruelty-free, per Summer Fridays
Skin: lips; bedtime mask or daytime balm
Skip it if you want a matte lip or a plain unscented balm.

checks: Finish: sheer tint with a soft shine; it is not matte.
Scent: Vanilla is the classic; other scents exist if vanilla is not for you.
Size: a 0.5 oz tube, so it lives in a purse or on the nightstand.
page_notes.fit: A thick balm for bedtime that doubles as a daytime shine, and a safe beauty gift.
page_notes.not_fit: Matte lips or a plain unscented balm.

products.image_alt: A Summer Fridays Lip Butter Balm tube on a bedside table at night beside a lamp, a glass of water and a folded blanket.

products.title: ELEMIS Pro-Collagen Cleansing Balm, 100 g
products.reason_to_buy: A cleansing balm that takes off makeup and sunscreen in one step and rinses with a damp cloth: the classic beauty gift.
products.detail:
We chose it for the first step of a nighttime routine: it melts makeup and sunscreen without stripping.
+ Warm a pea-sized amount, massage 60 seconds, remove with a damp cloth
+ Doubles as a weekly mask, per ELEMIS
+ Mineral-oil-free, with elderberry, starflower and Optimega oils
Size: 100 g jar (3.5 oz)
Formula: lavender, chamomile and eucalyptus scent
Skin: all types; patch test if fragrance bothers you
Skip it if you want fragrance-free: it is scented.

checks: Scent: lavender, chamomile and eucalyptus. Skip it if fragrance bothers your skin, and patch-test if unsure.
How to use: warm a pea-sized amount, massage 60 seconds, remove with a damp cloth; ELEMIS says it doubles as a weekly mask.
Size: the 100 g (3.5 oz) jar lasts months at a pea-sized dose.

page_notes.not_fit: Fragrance-free routines.

products.image_alt: An ELEMIS Pro-Collagen Cleansing Balm jar on a bathroom counter at night beside a folded muslin cloth, a small plant and warm lamp light.

products.title: Kindle Paperwhite fabric cover (2024)
products.reason_to_buy: The official fabric cover for the 2024 Paperwhite and Colorsoft: wakes and sleeps the Kindle, folds back for one-handed reading.
products.detail:
We chose it as the add-on for the Paperwhite on our list: it protects the screen and keeps the reader light.
+ Opens and closes like a book to wake or sleep the Kindle
+ Folds flat behind for one-handed reading; stays on for charging
+ Water-safe fabric; magnets keep it closed
Fits: Kindle Paperwhite and Paperwhite Signature Edition (2024 release only), Kindle Colorsoft and Colorsoft Signature Edition
Weight: about 5 oz
Skip it if your Paperwhite is from 2021 or earlier: this cover does not fit it.

checks: Fit: the 2024 Paperwhite and Paperwhite Signature Edition, plus the Colorsoft models. It does not fit a 2021-or-earlier Paperwhite or the basic Kindle.
Find your model first: Settings, then Device Info on the Kindle, or your order page.
Weight: about 5 oz, and it stays on for charging.
page_notes.fit: Owners of the 2024 Paperwhite who want wake-and-sleep on open and one-handed reading.
page_notes.not_fit: Older Paperwhite models; buy the cover made for that year instead.

products.image_alt: A Kindle Paperwhite in a fabric cover, folded open on a reading chair at night with a throw blanket, a mug and a lamp.

products.title: FURminator deShedding tool, large dogs
products.reason_to_buy: The undercoat tool for long-haired dogs over 50 lb: reaches loose undercoat without cutting the topcoat, then ejects it with a button.
products.detail:
We chose it for pet parents who vacuum every day: less loose undercoat on the dog means less on the couch.
+ Stainless steel edge reaches through the topcoat to loose undercoat
+ FURejector button releases the collected hair
